info.name: SchoolOS API
info.description:
SchoolOS backend (NestJS). All routes are under `/api/v1` except the health check. Generated from the controllers and DTOs.

**Getting started:** import the `SchoolOS Local` environment, set `identifier` and `password` (seed users are `superadmin@schoolos.local`, `admin@<dsn|dss>.schoolos.local`, etc.; password is the `SEED_PASSWORD` used when seeding), then run **Auth → POST /auth/login**. The login test script stores `accessToken`/`refreshToken`, which every other request sends as a Bearer token.

IDs in path/query/body (`{{studentId}}`, `{{sectionId}}`, …) are collection variables — fill them in from list responses.

Authenticated (global JWT guard, no @Public). A wrong-current-password endpoint is an online guessing surface for a stolen access token, so it gets the same throttle as login.

**Roles:** TEACHER, SCHOOL_ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Read-only: school admins and teachers need this to pick a session when uploading report cards and other school-level operations, even though the write routes below stay SUPER_ADMIN-only (session definitions are structural, like Schools/Campuses/Classes).
**Roles:** any authenticated user (row-level access is enforced in the service layer)

**Roles:** TEACHER, SCHOOL_ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Staff-only (no StudentAccessService involved for PARENT, since @Roles already excludes that role) — the roster-marking screen's pre-fill, now campus/tenant-scoped like every other section-level route.
**Roles:** any authenticated user (row-level access is enforced in the service layer)

**Roles:** SCHOOL_ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Returns a file/PDF/CSV download, not JSON — use Send and Download.

request.description:
**Roles:** SCHOOL_ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Admin-only for now — the one consumer today is the Timetable editor, which is itself Admin/Super Admin only (matches POST /timetable's existing @Roles).

**Roles:** any authenticated user (row-level access is enforced in the service layer)

No StudentAccessService check — terms are not per-student PII, same reasoning as Holiday's read scope (any authenticated role, including PARENT/TEACHER, can read the term list).
**Roles:** any authenticated user (row-level access is enforced in the service layer)

**Roles:** SCHOOL_ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Staff-only (no StudentAccessService involved) — this is the Timetable editor's read side, listing what's already scheduled for a section so it can be shown/edited, not a parent-facing read.

**Roles:** SCHOOL_ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

The grid composer's bulk save — replaces the section's entire timetable in one call.
